jobs.title: Software Engineer, License Client and Platform, IAR
jobs.description:
About Us

Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.

Our software and development tools help build products used in cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries around the world. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.

Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.

We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.

About The Role

IAR is part of Qt Group, operating as an independent business focused on embedded software development. We provide software development tools that help engineers develop, debug, test, and secure embedded software for products across automotive, industrial automation, medical technology, and other industries.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer for the team that owns IAR's license management platform. It’s the system that lets customers access and run IAR's software tools, whether through a cloud-based, subscription-ready platform or on-premises. The team works across the full stack, from the client software installed on developers' machines to the services and infrastructure behind it.

As a Software Engineer, you'll take ownership of the license client components used across IAR's product portfolio, while getting exposure to the wider platform and plenty of room to grow in the direction that interests you.

What You’ll Do

Develop and maintain the license client software used across IAR's products to access and validate licenses.
Support and evolve our cloud-based, subscription licensing platform alongside our on-premises offering.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the client and backend services, including occasional work in our license back-office systems.
Collaborate closely with the rest of the team on architecture, priorities, and technical decisions.
Get involved in wider platform work, including web services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.

What You Bring to the Table

Professional experience in C++ software development.
Automation and scripting skills in Python or similar languages.
Experience building or integrating web services and APIs.
Comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments.
Experience with containerized development using Docker.
Good communication skills in English.

Bonus Points For...

Exposure to cloud technologies (e.g. Azure), microservices, or Kubernetes.
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, Git/GitLab, or Artifactory.
Experience with C# and/or Java, useful for our license back-office and integration services.

Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.

We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.

Flexibility You Can Count On We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.
Meaningful Wellbeing Support From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.
Opportunities to Grow Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.
Inclusive by Design You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.
Rewarding Your Impact Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.

Bring Your Whole Self

The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.

We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.

jobs.title: Senior ServiceNow Architect — CPQ / Sales and Order Management (AI-focused) - Hybrid (Madrid)
jobs.location: Tres Cantos, Community of Madrid, Spain
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior ServiceNow Architect
to join projects focused on the development, evolution and transformation of solutions on the ServiceNow platform
, with a particular focus on Sales and Order Management (SOM), Customer Service Management (CSM) and CPQ
.

The selected candidate will play a key role in designing and developing CPQ and Quote-to-Order solutions
, working with ServiceNow technologies and Artificial Intelligence capabilities such as Now Assist and AI Agent Studio
.

We are looking for professionals with at least 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow
, experience in CRM/Industry Workflows solutions, and hands-on experience developing AI capabilities on the Now Platform. Knowledge of CPQ, Logik.ai and Quote-to-Cash processes will be highly valued.

Responsibilities

Design, develop and configure solutions on ServiceNow, particularly across Sales and Order Management, CSM and CPQ.
Develop and enhance functionality related to product catalogues, product configuration, pricing, discounts, quoting and order orchestration.
Develop CPQ solutions, including configuration rules, pricing logic and integration with the wider order lifecycle.
Design and develop AI capabilities using Now Assist and AI Agent Studio, including agents, skills and prompts to support business and sales processes.
Develop integrations between ServiceNow and external systems using REST APIs, IntegrationHub and custom spokes.
Develop Scoped Applications, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flows and UI components.
Translate business requirements related to products, pricing, discounts and approvals into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
Provide technical guidance and support to junior and mid-level developers.
Contribute to the definition of best practices, standards and reusable components.
Support the technical estimation and definition of projects and solutions.

Requirements

Must-have

Minimum 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow.
Proven experience in ServiceNow development and architecture.
Experience working with CRM and Industry Workflows, particularly Sales and Order Management, CSM, Product Catalogue or Order Management.
Hands-on experience developing AI capabilities on the Now Platform, using technologies such as Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, AI Agents, Virtual Agent or Predictive Intelligence.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript, GlideRecord, server-side and client-side scripting, Script Includes, Business Rules and ACLs.
Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub and Scoped Applications.
Experience with integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth/JWT, Transform Maps and data import processes.
Experience with Now Assist / AI Agent Studio, including agent and skill configuration and prompt design.
Experience developing user interfaces using UI Builder, Now Experience or Service Portal.
Experience with Automated Test Framework (ATF) and source control using Git.
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification.
Strong teamwork skills and a quality-oriented approach to development.
Advanced level of English.

Nice to have

CIS certification in a CRM product line, particularly CIS-CSM.
Experience with Logik.ai.
Previous experience in CPQ, including product configuration, business rules, pricing, discounts and Quote-to-Cash processes.
Experience with other CPQ platforms such as Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud, Oracle CPQ, SAP CPQ/Callidus, Conga, PROS or Tacton.
Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures, including MCP-based integrations and multi-agent orchestration.
Experience in industries involving complex products, such as manufacturing, high-tech, telecommunications, industrial or medical devices.
Experience working with Agile methodologies.

Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to translate business requirements into structured, scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
Strong focus on quality and software development best practices.
Excellent communication skills with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Ability to analyse requirements, propose alternatives and communicate risks and potential solutions.
Technical leadership skills and ability to mentor other developers.
Comfortable working in fast-evolving technology environments, particularly across ServiceNow and Artificial Intelligence.

What We Offer

Opportunity to participate in projects focused on the transformation and evolution of ServiceNow solutions.
Training and professional development in CPQ, Logik.ai and ServiceNow AI capabilities.
Support for obtaining and maintaining ServiceNow certifications.
Opportunity to work on CRM transformation and process automation projects.
Collaborative working environment with strong opportunities for professional development.
Hybrid working model.

We firmly believe that companies and clients set the path to follow in the sector, but that path is built by people. We consider it essential that our organization is based on our greatest asset and added-value differentiator, which is our people.
